scientific_integrity.computed_evidence: Deterministic standard-library verification on synthetic model parameters only.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact stationary-sign analysis; monotonic peak-height envelope; local cubic-cusp and high-contrast asymptotic expansions.
scientific_integrity.unproved_scope: No independent scientific validation, field-data confirmation, or global coverage of all historical articles.

scientific_limitations: Exact only for two horizontally co-located elevated Gaussian point sources with fixed heights, steady wind, reflected ground, no deposition or reaction, and plume widths proportional to downwind distance.
Does not predict regulatory exposure or general two-dimensional maxima under variable wind and terrain.
The two-gamma-mixture bimodality criterion is already present in the literature; no novelty is claimed for that subresult.
Historical priority for the global-height crossing and its asymptotics is provisional, especially given general mixture-mode and bitangency literature.
title: A unique emission-ratio switch between two Gaussian-plume ground-level hotspots
